subject: 🎓 RSVP Confirmed — $ceremony_name ($rsvp_status_display)
body:
Dear $student_name,

This email confirms your RSVP for your graduation ceremony. Congratulations once again — we can't wait to celebrate with you!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
YOUR RSVP
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Response:        $rsvp_status_display
Guests booked:   $num_guests
Recorded:        $rsvp_recorded_on

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CEREMONY DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Ceremony:        $ceremony_name
Date:            $ceremony_date

Venue:           $venue

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
YOUR SEAT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

$seat_info
$accessibility_line

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ON THE DAY

  1. Arrive in good time for robing — you cannot cross the stage without your gown.
  2. Make your way to your allocated seat shown above.
  3. Your guests should bring their tickets and take their seats before the procession begins.

If you need to change your response or your seat is not yet shown, please contact the Graduation Office before the RSVP deadline.

With warmest congratulations,
The Graduation Office
